_comment: Regex guards against claims the candidate cannot back. A hit flags the decode or pack text; in a CV tagline or summary it replaces the model's text with the vetted version. Case-insensitive JavaScript regex. Anchor each rule on the candidate's own verb (managed, ran, owned ...), so the posting's words ("P&L ownership", "you will manage a team") are not flagged.

rules.why: Alex mentored two junior PMs but never managed a product team.
At Parcelpoint Alex owned carrier integrations only, not the whole platform.
Alex ran two pricing experiments; no experimentation program.
Alex gave input to budgets but never owned a P&L.
